What are they doing?
May 2016 • Couples
Mercure is not a bad international chain hotel. That's why we decided to have a dinner at its Brasserie Le Pavillon restaurant, just hoping to have a good dinner before leaving Hanoi. Unfortunately, it's a nightmare.

Please refer to the attached photo, a group of local people came in playing around noisily, but eventually they're gone after playing enough without eating. The restaurant staff just didn't care. Absolutely, that's not a good place for fine dining.

We wanted to have Coke Zero. Sorry, no. Please order Pepsi light. OK!? We wanted to have Duck Confit. Sorry again, no. We then needed to order Sea Bass without much choice, but turned out to be Chinese cooking style. The seafood soup is almost the same. A restaurant with French name in a French brand hotel serving Chinese style food? Kidding? Fine!! 

I reminded the waiter twice to cook the lamb rack as medium rare, but it's over cooked as more than medium. After informing its manager, it's returned for replacement. Yes, it's medium rare this time, but please refer to the photo how good it is. The fat is equivalent to around 30%. Obviously, that's an inferior quality probably due to the replacement. I then asked them to cancel it. Originally, I planned to have a full-course meal with dessert there, but I was totally disappointed with their quality of food and lousy management there. Eventually, I needed to find some other place for dining after that.

I really don't know what they are doing. If you're looking for a place for happy hour drinks, may be it's worth a try. However, if you're looking for a good place for fine dining, my experience telling you that it's not the right place definitely.
